Hero_Desc_Alice:
An affable phantom who reads cards filled with the power of foresight.
Getting a card reading done for fun will lead to certain regret after realizing how unlucky you are.
Album_Like_Alice: Her card deck. Her reflection in the mirror.
Album_Hate_Alice: Mentions of 'rabbit' or 'tea' in front of her. Latte.
Album_Wish_Alice: A wish coming true as it is.
Album_Alice1: The phantom that guards the phantom society's gate when you first enter. In truth, Alice not the official gatekeeper. Rather, she resides on the outskirts of town. She also has an affinity for divination items like tarot cards, mirrors, and amulets.
Album_Alice2: Much like Shaydi, Alice also enjoys playing pranks on others. She tries to get a rise out by using mirrors that distort your image, and by rigging tarot cards to the readings are deliberately tragic.
Album_Alice3: It bothers Alice that the witches are immune to her pranks; they seem to see through the phantoms' tricks. Her life... No, her phantom goal in life is to one day play a 'grand prank' on the witches.
Album_Alice4: I asked Alice to genuinely tell my future, but sure enough, she ignored my request, jokingly predicting 'a lifetime of being haunted by Alice.' When I said, 'Doesn't seem like a bad thing,' she suddenly frowned, grimacing in disgust.
Album_Alice5: Alice makes her cards by hand. Each card is adorned with her own drawings and writings, and she also uses her own magic to make the tarot cards magical. Initially, she only used one card for readings, and they were arbitrarily assigned meaning.
Album_Alice6: I then became suddenly curious if phantoms can read the fortunes of other phantoms. When I asked Alice this question, she said divination is mostly about making things up as you go.
Album_Alice7: At first, I didn't understand the point of Alice's fortune-reading since she just makes up readings on the spot. But then I realized... even if she doesn't actually predict the future, her readings still have an uncanny tendency to come true.

Food_ChefNote_Alice_Hate1:
Alice took a sip of the beverage and spat it all out. 
She threw the americano in my face, telling me to bring her a real drink.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Hate2: Alice complained she lost her appetite, saying these unkempt grasses grow all over the marsh where she lives.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like1:
Alice enjoys drinking tea on the balcony, saying it's an elegant beverage that suits her. 
The fact that this lemon tea came from an instant mix will forever be our secret.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like2:
Alice likes eating this pudding with tea. 
She says they go well together. She seems to enjoy dipping the phantom pudding into her tea and watching it flail about.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like3: Alice asked to mix the powder with water and have it heated. She says it tastes like well-brewed lemon tea.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like4: Alice has the foresight to only pick out those filled with honey. But because of her, there is a run on the honey songpyeon.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like5: Alice suggested that placing the bottle beside the cards would make the House of Fortune look more mystical and asked for the bottle itself.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like6: Alice came expecting a delicious meal based on her fortune reading and said it exceeded her expectations.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like7: Alice found it funny that humans celebrate New Year's with such food.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like8: Alice didn't want to get her cards dirty and asked for a fork. She ate it scattering crumbs all over.
Food_ChefNote_Alice_Like9: Alice said it's the kind of taste that builds anticipation, smugly adding that it suits her well.
